reading.objective: Announce a two-day technology conference on open infrastructure and drive ticket sales.
reading.audience: Engineers, platform and network people, open-source maintainers and policy folk.
reading.feeling: Confident, structural, industrial and honest: infrastructure you can see through.

concept.idea: Nested structural frames, each with a gap, are crossed by a single signal line: infrastructure is open when something can pass through every layer.
decisions: structure: the open frames sit in the upper right and the very large headline fills the lower two thirds as a block, so the sheet reads as a machine hall with a heavy base
read first: the headline Open Systems 2027, then the signal line leading out through the gaps, then the details and ticket button
type: Archivo at heavy weight, tightly tracked, for a plant-sign headline; Space Grotesk for the technical small text
colour: warm paper ground, near-black ink, one signal orange used only for the line, the core, the year and the button
forms: three nested open squares with aligned gaps and a through-line, set over a faint engineering grid; nothing decorative beyond that
